notes: Summary: large EU-based marketplace platform; unify search across product catalog + seller docs + support tickets in 12 languages (EN, FR, DE, ES, NL, IT, PT, PL, SV, DA, NO, RO).
Primary ask: embeddings + reranking pipeline that can scale to ~400M docs, support incremental indexing, and per-language recall/precision tuning. Want ability to tune reranker per language/domain.
Latency/throughput targets: median query latency <200ms (95th <450ms) for single-shot search; target 1k QPS in peak city events (burst to 5k).
Cost constraint: target <$0.008 per query for typical top-K retrieval + rerank pipeline; looking for cost breakdown transparency (embedding store, reranker tokens, GPU runtime).
Model preference: open models preferred; evaluate 7B/13B quantized variants for reranker, 2-4B embedder variants. Consider Redwood verified model profiles.
Routing/availability: want regional routing (EU primary) + fallbacks to hosted with encryption in transit; strict data residency on indexing and audit logs.
Quote from head of search: "We need per-language recall metrics — English is fine, but Spanish/Polish are noisier; we need knobs for precision vs recall per locale."
Timeline: 8-week POC focused on 3 priority languages (EN, FR, DE) then expand to remaining 9 languages during evaluation phase.
Security: must pass SOC2-like questionnaire, KMS integration required for keys, retention controls for indices older than 2 years.
Internal notes (AE): demo successful; SE to run per-language reranker calibration tests next. Legal pushed on residency and subprocessor list.
Pointers: see drive matrix for current per-language recall numbers; ticket INF-7821 opened for embedding store perf regression on large corpus ingestion.
